DEAP.label_finding: 439 valence and 439 arousal ratings differ from the included spreadsheet by 9-r. All 439 affected trials had spreadsheet valence >5 and arousal >5; all their binary valence labels flip. Independently downloaded upstream s01.dat and spreadsheet match local SHA-256 and reproduce 13 affected trials. The discrepancy is present in the upstream Kaggle version, before bundling.
DEAP.label_policy: Use spreadsheet ratings joined by Participant_id + Experiment_id; retain original pickle ratings and source hashes.

evidence.scope_limit: CRC32 is an integrity checksum, not a cryptographic hash. Six representative files have SHA-256 comparisons; the remaining source files were compared by size and CRC32. No first-party full-release comparison has been completed. No EEG or rating source file was changed.
